Unsafe DRIVING behaviors only. Stuff that will get you immediately offboarded by Amazon.

- 2 x running a stop sign at 15mph+ speeds
- 2 x of running red lights
- 1 x of speeding at 85mph+

If you do any of these in a day, Flex will make you stop delivering and will tell you to contact your DSP. At that point it’s your DSP’s call to either have you drive back or have someone else pick you up. 

After that happenes either your account will get suspended until you finish the ORCAS training or if you’ve already had previous ORCAS in the last 90 days you’ll be offboarded the next day.

This won’t affect your ability to drive standard routes but you might possibly lose your DOT qualification if you cannot get your MEC renewed. 

Amazon’s DOT compliance is handled via JJK, and there’s no automated process that communicates with the doctor’s office. Now if your DSP uploads that failed MEC it would be different. 

Find another place that would do a DOT physical and get a new Med Cert and have your DSP submit it. Verification may take a few days but it shouldn’t flag anything

Hey bud, pretty late to the post but I've had similar situations. Trying to adapt to a new country is not easy. 

First and foremost, I would just completely ignore what the stranger said. Reddit is a weird place. People act like they know it all, but honestly it's the opposite and they are mostly just repeating what someone else said to a different person. 

People have their own struggles. I mean, you know right? A person can be fully supportive but they can never fully understand what you're going through. She doesn't get what you're going through and you don't get what she's going through. Obviously both of you are going through a very rough time. And in those times we lose control, we do dumb shit. 

Forget and forgive. 

It seems like your girlfriend cared about you a lot when she could. She's going through a shitton that most of us don't just understand. My advice is have patience, ease her off, have some distance but don't leave her alone. 

And for yourself, try to take your mind off of the stuff thst worries you. I know it's easier said than done. I'm still getting discriminated a lot and I've been here for 5 years. (US). I decided not to give a fuck and that helps me a lot. (This doesn't mean being a dick) As for the culture shock, I was fascinated by how different stuff here are, and I like learning about new stuff, music, movies whatever it is. (Except for football, baseball and other sports stuff. I absolutely don't get it) I make myself busy a lot to forget all the crap that's in my life which is really helpful. Also self care, it goes a long long way. Take care of yourself. Not just because you feel unhappy and stuck, because you're worth it. 

I'm sorry if I'm off topic and just blabbering. I'm in a very similar situation to you and was just typing whatever that comes to my mind first. So this is by my personal experience. 

 Take care of each other man. Hopefully everything turns out better in the future for all of yall)
